title: Thorned Roses
description: A texture pack for the stall Thorned Roses in TTRP's server
body:
This texture pack was made for stall in TallTalesRP!
Its content is mostly jewellery and accessories so far but were planning to add more! The purpose is to create a beautiful environment, make the server more inclusive in a way, and show what great minds can bring up when they work together!

Most of the jewellery/accessory items you can just place in your off hand to use, but some may be attached to the head. 

CIT is required!! https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn

If you would like to request a commission, this is the form to do so:
https://forms.gle/W4FnCAQioctudk6x8

None of the textures are to be made on your own. You would have to buy them in game, Unless you commissioned an item.

You may be wondering if you stumble upon this and your not to sure why this was made? Well heres a brief description of TallTalesRP. 

TallTalesRP is a whitelisted medieval‑fantasy Minecraft server set in the richly imagined realm of Eldorath. Players can roleplay unique characters, build nations, and learn elemental magic in a survival‑based system.
 If your interested in joining heres the link to the server website!
https://talltalesrp.net
